text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Func-Citation and tions and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1993 and shall be deemed commence· to have come into force on the 1st. January, 1994. ment.

In this Order unless the context otherwise requires-Interpretation. ''Functions'' includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law Functions. specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.
